items.question: What is riasly?
items.answer: riasly is a creator-first platform that pairs customizable link-in-bio profile pages with fast, secure file hosting — all behind one clean, memorable handle.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan lets you build a full profile and host files at no cost, forever. Premium unlocks lifetime extras like custom domains and unlimited hosting with a single payment.

items.question: Is it safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. Files are served over an encrypted global edge network with private links and optional password protection. Your handle and content stay under your control.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Under two minutes. Sign up, claim your riasly/ handle, drop in your links, and publish. No code, no config, no waiting.

footer.blurb: Everything you want, right here. Link pages and file hosting built for creators and gamers.
